_comment: Legislature status, which no query in this app can answer.
The Wikidata queries return chambers and seat counts. They do not say whether a
legislature is currently sitting, dissolved ahead of an election, suspended by a
coup, or absent by constitutional design — and those four states are the whole
difference between 'no chambers listed' meaning 'we have no data' and meaning
'this country has no legislature'. Rule 30: no answer is not an answer of no.
So status is seeded and cited, exactly as military-seed.json seeds the facts FAS
publishes and Wikidata does not. Citations live in data/ rather than src/ because
registry-coverage.test.ts requires every host appearing in src/ to be a registered
fetch target, and a citation is not a fetch target.
Step 10 replaces this with an ingest. What it must NOT do is collapse the four
states into two, which is the same warning UNEXERCISED-PATHS records for

GBR.note: The House of Lords is appointed and hereditary rather than elected. A seat count beside an elected chamber's implies a comparability that does not exist, so the selection method is stated rather than left for the reader to assume.

ISL.note: Unicameral. Wikidata models the Althing as the legislative body itself rather than as a chamber of one, which is why the chamber query keeps a body that has no chamber children.

SAU.note: The Consultative Assembly is appointed and advisory. MEASURED 2026-08-15: Saudi Arabia's Wikidata P194 points at 'Government of Saudi Arabia' (P31 government), which reaches no chamber type at any depth including an unbounded walk; the Assembly exists as Q818708 with 150 seats and nothing links it to the country. So the live query returns zero chambers for a reason that is upstream data, not our query.

LBY.note: Rival bodies have claimed legislative authority. A single chamber row rendered without that context asserts a settled legislature, which is the confident-falsehood failure this project exists to prevent.

VAT.note: The Pontifical Commission is appointed and exercises delegated authority. It is returned by the chamber query because Wikidata types it as a legislative body; calling it a parliament without qualification would be wrong.
